product_metadata.title: Range Kleen Double Step Gray Folding Stool 19.5 Inches L by 20 Inches W by 17 Inches H
features: REACH HIGHER WITH THIS ALL AROUND UTILITY: This 2 Step folding stool by Range Kleen provides that height to reach those items or places on any room in your home, office or workshop.

BUILT WITH MATERIALS THAT ARE MADE TO LAST: The Range Kleen SS2 Double Step Folding Stool is made of a rigid, sturdy plastic designed for durability that holds up to 300 lbs. It has a non slip rubber grips on fit and the gray color hides dirt.
IDEAL DIMENSIONS FOR ANY ROOM: When unfolded and in use, the dimensions 19.5 inches L x 20 inches W x 17 inches H and when folded for storage is 21.25 inches L X 1.5 inches W x 25.5 inches H
FEATURES GALORE: Fold the stool for compact storage or hang it with the loop it has. No need to worry as the two step on this product provides stability.
USE IT ANYWHERE: This product is ideal for any home, office and workshop. It is also great for travelling RV’s and campers.
description: The Range Kleen SS2 Double Step is an ideal addition for any room in your home. Store this folding step stool almost anywhere and even take on the go with its super-compact, portable design. It supports up to 300 pounds with a rigid and sturdy plastic. Get those 17.5 inches additional reach. Enjoy even more stability with extra-wide steps that feature no-slip traction pads and rubber feet for added balance.
